method: Five independently seeded, full-original-context native-choice generations; vote on exact valid native keys; preserve one whole winning response.
controls: Preassigned draw0 and mean over all five single draws. M5 also one matched unguided draw0; M4 original schema was already constrained.
evidence: DiversityMedQA Maj@5 original inference method, adapted to local JSON multi-field tasks and original backbones.
scope: Same exposed development 64 R5 units plus 8 weak relevant-change controls; no paired endpoint, R label, gold or source label enters inference.
decoding_changes: Both backbones use existing M4 native schema. Same .7 temperature, 2048 max output, full original contexts. More KV capacity and batch parallelism, shared across new controls.
decision: Evaluate both original backbones and reference/variant/both metrics. Vote gains must be separated from format-only and new prompt effects; no per-source/model winner mixture.
composite_task: M22 retains complete errors and reasoning from the preassigned first winning sample; document correction quality is separately evaluated, not claimed improved by main-answer voting.
